text:
Alex: deploy-bot flagged a p95 spike on /v1/generate during canary. deploy-bot: p95 +36% vs baseline, error rate +0.8%. Suggestion: hold rollout; auto-revert threshold reached.

deploy-bot: suggested_action=hold; suggest_autorevert=true; details: metric=p95 latency; window=5m

Jamie: seeing a cluster of 5xx traces from eu-west. Logs: https://logs.internal/r/abcd — kv-cache misses spiking around the same time.

Sasha: i want to avoid an auto-revert that affects other tenants. propose a manual rollback to 3.8.2 and pin eu pools until we confirm kv-cache fix. Ops Lead, can you take the exec?

Ops Lead: on it. will run rollback + pin. who owns release notes + customer comms?

Alex: i got release notes and cust-comm. i'll freeze release notes and draft a short customer blurb: "We observed increased latency during a canary rollout; we reverted to the previous stable version and are investigating." legal cc'd.

Jamie: rollback command ready: ```bash
/deploy rollback --service=inference --to-version=3.8.2 --reason='canary p95 spike'
```

Ops Lead: executing now. tagging @oncall, starting a 15m maintenance window. will post status updates here.

deploy-bot: Rollback initiated (job_id=8421). progress=0% -> 100%. ETA ~2m. auto-revert suppressed by manual override.

Sasha: after rollback please pin eu dedicated pools to 3.8.2 for 2h and run smoke tests + kv-cache telemetry. smaller canary slice on next attempt.

Ops Lead: pinned EU dedicated pool to 3.8.2. traffic back to stable. p95 back to baseline on initial checks. :white_check_mark:

Alex: customer comm draft posted in #customer-updates for review: https://docs.internal/drafts/rollback-eu-canary. please review quickly.

Jamie: filing follow-up ticket INF-2391 with logs, deploy flags, and canary metrics. assigning to eng-runtime.

deploy-bot: auto-revert disabled (manual_override=true). note: rollback provenance saved to job 8421.

Sasha: good. next steps: RCA (kv-cache edge case), run targeted canary with telemetry, and update the Optimize recommendations if needed.

Ops Lead: closing thread for now. will update INF-2391 with RCA and next rollout plan. :lock:
